verdict.rationale: Google's own Data API docs point users to an MCP server for Google Analytics installable from GitHub, and a probe confirms the official repository under the googleanalytics org, so an agent can connect via a first-party MCP server. The evidence establishes existence and provenance but little depth. Missing for 10: documentation of the server's tool set, auth setup and connection steps, any hands-on or independent corroboration, and clarity on maturity (the 'Try' wording suggests it may be early-stage).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Try the MCP server for Google Analytics. Install from GitHub, and see the announcement for more details.
